name: bounded Decode-call-cost worker selection
evidence: workers-pilot-v1: 6 workers win ambient, 5 win cpu25; simple external-CPU threshold rejected after pressure-diagnostic-v1
scope: CPU-only frozen NEW_A kernels, eight distinct sequence Decode calls; same 6-CPU upper envelope
learning_exclusion: first call per four-call block only; every call and transition remains in primary cohort wall
fallback: 6 unless clear win; UNKNOWN/MIXED6; existing single-token Decode5 preserved
hold: remaining continuous episode only; no cross-request or warmup learning carry
controls: same binary sampled fixed6 for eligible calls
same binary sampled fixed5 for eligible calls
shadow_control_note: Control executes fixed profiles while retaining timing and shadow schedule/math. Shadow5 costs in fixed6 are costs of actual6, never evidence of actual5 execution.
limitations: Decode call is not universally one graph
sequence identity and positions do not prove identical KV padding/graph shape
two balanced cycles reduce but do not eliminate history/nonlinear drift
2%/4% learner thresholds are not statistical success gates
short episodes may pay probe cost without reaching a choice
phase-specific benefit must not be conflated with generic resource adaptation

estimated_opportunity.source: workers-pilot-v1, not a guarantee for adaptive policy
estimated_opportunity.costs: All 32 probe calls, worker transitions and timing/decision overhead remain in cohort wall; useful gain can be smaller or negative.
